competitorWins: Intelligence X is the reference search engine for the hidden internet: it indexes the darknet, leaked databases, stealer logs, breached credentials, historical documents, and paste sites in ways no general tool — including WorldEye — comes close to, with identity.intelx.io going further (reverse lookups, export of leaked accounts, stealer-log exports) for advanced researchers. The free SDK and Maltego transform also make it a first-class building block in investigation toolchains. Its free tiers are unusually generous for this class of tool. WorldEye's intelligence feeds are surface-level news/cyber summaries; Intelligence X is archival deep-search, a genuinely different and deeper capability.
description: Intelligence X (Austria) is a search engine and data archive for the hidden internet — darknet, leaked databases, breached credentials, stealer logs, documents, and historical archives — searchable by strong selectors (email, domain, IP, phone, Bitcoin address, hashes). It's an archival deep-search tool for security researchers; WorldEye is a live visual-monitoring platform (3D globe, flights, ships, 74,229 cameras, weather) with only surface-level intel feeds. Complementary layers: deep archival search vs live world-state.

verdictWorldEye: Choose WorldEye if you want free, instant live situational awareness — the live 3D globe with flights, ships, 74,229 cameras, weather, and events, plus an affordable Pro tier for AI analysis and intel feeds.
whyWorldEye: WorldEye's live map is free with no signup — open worldeye.app and the 3D globe, flights, ships, weather, and 74,229 public cameras are immediately available.

Pro (from $3.99/week) adds an AI analyst assistant, OSINT toolkit, premium intel feeds, and high-res satellite imagery — far below €2,500/yr research pricing.
